title: Outbound Sales Voice Agent with DND and Consent Checks
summary: An outbound voice agent that dials only numbers cleared against DND preferences, consent records and your opt-out list, pitches within approved scripts and logs every consent outcome.

seo.title: Outbound Voice Agent with DND and Consent Checks | VipraTech
seo.description: Outbound AI calling for telecom and BPO campaigns with pre-dial DND, consent and calling-window checks, approved scripts and per-call consent logs.

problem.intro: Outbound campaigns for plan upgrades, postpaid migration, broadband and add-ons run on lead lists of uneven quality. Calling someone who has registered a DND preference or withdrawn consent, calling outside permitted hours, or overstating an offer creates complaints and regulatory exposure, and a voice agent that dials at scale multiplies the problem if the checks are not built in.

pain_points.title: Scrubbing is a separate step
pain_points.detail: Lists reach the dialler unscrubbed or with stale results because preference checks sit outside the dialling path.

pain_points.title: Consent records are scattered
pain_points.detail: Consent captured on web forms, apps and in stores lives in different systems, so proving it for a given call is hard.

pain_points.title: Scripts drift
pain_points.detail: Human and automated callers improvise offers and benefits that marketing and compliance never approved.

pain_points.title: Capacity wasted on poor contacts
pain_points.detail: Wrong numbers, repeat attempts and uninterested contacts consume dialler time and annoy customers.

solution.overview: We build an outbound voice agent with the compliance checks inside the dialling path rather than beside it. Before each call, the number is checked against DND preference data available through your DLT or telemarketer arrangement, your consent records, your internal opt-out list and the permitted calling window. Only cleared numbers are dialled. The agent introduces itself and the brand, says it is an automated assistant, pitches only offers from the approved catalogue in Hindi, Hinglish or English, and handles common objections. Opt-outs are recorded and suppressed across campaigns immediately. Interested customers are booked for a human callback or sent an activation link, and every call writes a consent and outcome log.
capabilities: Pre-dial checks against DND preference data, consent records, the internal opt-out list and permitted calling hours
Approved script and offer catalogue enforced at runtime, with no invented pricing or benefits
Brand identification, automated-assistant disclosure and opt-out handling on every call
Objection handling and qualification in Hindi, Hinglish and English
Warm transfer or callback booking with a human sales agent for interested customers
Per-call consent, disclosure and outcome log for compliance review

workflow.title: Load the campaign list
workflow.detail: Leads and eligibility data for the approved campaign are loaded with their consent references.

workflow.title: Run pre-dial checks
workflow.detail: Each number is checked for DND preference, consent, opt-out and calling window; failures are suppressed with a reason.

workflow.title: Dial and disclose
workflow.detail: Cleared numbers are called, and the agent identifies the brand and states that it is automated.

workflow.title: Pitch and qualify
workflow.detail: The agent presents approved offers, answers from approved information and handles objections.

workflow.title: Act on the response
workflow.detail: Opt-outs are suppressed at once, and interested customers go to a human sales agent or receive an activation link.

workflow.title: Log the outcome
workflow.detail: Consent status, disclosures made and the call outcome are written to the log and the CRM.

inputs: Campaign lead lists with eligibility data
DND preference and consent data through your DLT or telemarketer arrangement
Approved scripts and offer catalogue per language
outputs: Consent and disclosure log per call
human_in_the_loop: Compliance approves the script, disclosures, offer catalogue and calling windows before a campaign starts. Qualified customers go to human sales agents for closure where your process requires it, and compliance reviews a sample of calls and every complaint.
integrations: Dialler or CCaaS such as Exotel, Ozonetel, Genesys or Amazon Connect
CRM such as Salesforce, LeadSquared or Zoho CRM
Payment or activation link service, including UPI payment links
WhatsApp Business API for follow-up messages
guardrails: No dial unless every pre-dial check passes
Opt-outs suppressed immediately across all campaigns
Offers limited to the approved catalogue
Calling windows and attempt caps enforced per number
Every call recorded and logged with its consent reference
compliance_notes: Designed to support TRAI's commercial-communication rules (TCCCPR 2018 and amendments), including customer preference and consent checks; your telemarketer registration and DLT obligations remain with you.
Lead lists and recordings are handled per the DPDP Act 2023, with consent and purpose limitation applied to each campaign.

pilot.scope: One campaign, such as broadband upgrades for existing customers with recorded consent, on a limited list with compliance sign-off.
deliverables: Pre-dial compliance service connected to your consent and preference data
Approved scripts in the pilot languages
Working outbound agent with human callback flow
Consent and outcome log with pilot report

what_we_measure.how: Audit of dialled and suppressed numbers against consent, preference and opt-out records.
QA review of sampled calls against the approved script and offer catalogue.
Test calls and logs confirming opt-outs were suppressed across campaigns.
Conversion of agent-qualified leads by the human sales team, compared with the current process.

faqs.q: How does DND scrubbing work with the DLT system?
faqs.a: Under TRAI's framework, preference and consent data is managed through DLT platforms run by access providers, and your telemarketer arrangement determines how scrubbing results reach you. We combine those results with your own consent records and opt-out list, and the agent will not dial a number that fails any check.

faqs.q: Will customers know they are talking to an AI?
faqs.a: Yes. The agent states the brand and that it is an automated assistant at the start of each call, and offers a human callback or an opt-out whenever asked.
Hindi, Hinglish and English at the start, with regional languages added after testing on your recordings. Scripts are approved per language rather than translated on the fly.

faqs.q: What if a customer asks something outside the script?
faqs.a: The agent answers only from approved product information and offers. Anything else, such as a complaint, a billing dispute or a detailed technical question, is logged and passed to a human team for a callback.
